reference_opening.argument: This video is non-scam content because it presents a procedural tutorial for moving a torrent or magnet link through Seedr and Internet Download Manager. The signup, magnet-link, and download-link steps are described as instructions for accessing a file, not as a financial offer or credential solicitation by the creator. External torrent and download services may raise separate legal or security questions, but those concerns do not themselves make the tutorial a scam.
